messages:
marta: Heads up — partner 'CloudTrade' sent a batch of POs from the marketplace and our PO ingester is rejecting them. Receiving this error from the vendor ledger:

kyle: what error? logs?

marta: "Missing required 'AcceptanceWindowStart' element; got numeric days instead of ISO timestamp". support ticket: https://redwood-infra.atlassian.net/browse/PO-4321

raj: that's an accounting blocker. Our AP system needs explicit start/end timestamps to calculate recognition windows.

olivia: from vendor side: marketplace export docs say AcceptanceWindow can be days. we've always mapped to today+N days. Can change mapping but need sign-off.

kyle: attaching sample payload we received:
```xml
<PurchaseOrder>
  <PONumber>CT-99214</PONumber>
  <AcceptanceWindow>30</AcceptanceWindow>
  <Total>12000</Total>
</PurchaseOrder>
```

marta: yes that's the shape. AP expects:
```xml
<PurchaseOrder>
  <PONumber>CT-99214</PONumber>
  <AcceptanceWindowStart>2026-03-01T00:00:00Z</AcceptanceWindowStart>
  <AcceptanceWindowEnd>2026-03-31T23:59:59Z</AcceptanceWindowEnd>
  <Total>12000</Total>
</PurchaseOrder>
```

olivia: vendor says they can switch to start/end timestamps but it will be a nonbackwards compatible change for some resellers — estimate 5 business days to roll out.

raj: can we accept a default mapping for now? e.g., map numeric days to start=today end=today+N and flag the PO for manual review.

kyle: technically doable as a hotfix in the ingester: if AcceptanceWindow is integer -> generate start/end based on received_ts. But we need ops sign-off and test coverage.

marta: proposal: 1) quick hotfix mapping to accept integer window for current batch (ops + eng to deploy by EOD), 2) prod change request to vendor to send ISO timestamps (OLIVIA to confirm timeline), 3) finance to accept manual review for legacy POs until vendor rollout.

marketplace-bot: New ticket created: PT-5582 linked to PO-4321. Assign to @kyle @olivia

kyle: I'll put up a small PR today, need @raj to confirm manual review workflow details and @marta to confirm scope of POs to backfill.

raj: I'll coordinate with AP and confirm criteria by EOD.

marta: thanks — will ping legal only if vendor needs a contract addendum. tagging @olivia to confirm vendor rollout plan.

olivia: confirmed — vendor will start timestamp payloads in 5 business days; they'll also provide a test endpoint. I'll update PT-5582.

marta: ok locking plan. if we see more malformed fields we'll open a broader incident. thx everyone :thumbsup:
